llm_response.reason: The website promises unrealistic guaranteed returns (up to 80% ROI), heavy psychological targeting ('We help your money grow' and instant withdrawals), focuses primarily on crypto deposits, lacks clear company information and verifiable credentials, uses urgency tactics, and mimics terminology and design of legitimate platforms. There is only one outbound hyperlink, which is odd and redirects to an error page, further raising suspicion. These features align strongly with the Investment Scam category.
